purpose: Resolve only GitHub-prepared stage-15 true SteamDB history misses through the scheduled ChatGPT runtime web path because direct GitHub Actions requests to SteamDB are systematically blocked with HTTP 403, while keeping scope, ordering, unresolved/retry state, completeness, validation and canonical persistence in GitHub. Valid confirmed facts may be persisted before the whole current scope is complete; unresolved keys remain GitHub-owned retries.

github_control_plane.rule: GitHub decides exactly which SteamDB entity keys require evidence, exposes only the current unresolved work input to ChatGPT, ingests returned facts, persists validated facts and decides whether the stage is complete.

owns: fetch exact public SteamDB evidence for keys in the current GitHub-prepared runtime work input
write structured runtime submission files containing only observed outcomes or transient failures
scheduled_chatgpt_data_plane.rule: ChatGPT is an external fact-fetch worker. It consumes the current GitHub-derived unresolved work file and submits facts; it does not calculate what remains or when the stage is complete.

interactive_chat.rule: An interactive user chat must not manually walk a large SteamDB manifest as a substitute for the scheduled GitHub↔ChatGPT production interface.

execution_scope.rule: The GitHub-prepared current scope is one production stage. ChatGPT may submit partial evidence because external access can fail. GitHub derives unresolved/retry state and completeness from submissions. A partial subset never means the stage is complete, but every non-conflicting validated fact in that subset may be checkpointed immediately while unresolved keys remain pending retries.

transport.reason: A controlled test on 2026-08-28 attempted all 51 stage-15 misses from GitHub Actions and SteamDB returned HTTP 403 for all 51, while the runtime web path could read the SteamDB price-history pages and exact Kazakhstan rows.

runtime_submission_contract.producer: scheduled ChatGPT runtime or explicit one-time recovery migration

runtime_result_rules.app_page_temporarily_unreadable: May use exact SteamDB purchase-package relationship only when the app identity, exact active package relationship and a KZT lowest price for the same purchase content are all independently proven from SteamDB; otherwise blocked_or_failure.
runtime_result_rules.403_429_timeout_network_or_5xx: blocked_or_failure; never persist as negative cache

pass_requires: every prepared resolved key has exactly one valid runtime resolution
prepared resolved keys exactly equal the resolved-key set in GitHub runtime state
current unresolved keys remain explicitly accounted for and are not written as negative results
confirmed minima are exact KZT values read from SteamDB evidence, never currency-converted estimates
previously-free and unavailable-exact-history are distinct statuses
all special relationship-derived values have explicit SteamDB relationship evidence
validated registry contains no blocked_or_failure result
diagnostic_stage_16.after_targeted_pass: restart downstream deterministic stages with all newly checkpointed facts; unresolved retries continue independently
